text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Today's the JBC Classic. And the
question on
everyone's lips is...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Have the three of us become equally
matched?
What do you think, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before, all Copano Rickey could do was
chase
after both Hokko Tarumae and
Wonder Acute.
choice_data_list: ああ、その通りだ！頑張っておいで！
うん、その通り！頑張ってね！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But now things are different. This will be
a test of
her growth. And as for the
other two...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Well, I've been training nonstop to make
up for
the time I missed!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I think, this time, I'll finally be able to
show you
the real me!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling bright-eyed and bushy-tailed.
You two
have given me more motivation
than I could ask
for.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to show you both today how
Wonder
Acute wins a race.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Both Tarumae and Acute are in perfect
form.
And since I am too...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(...the Four Guardians might finally be in
balance.
The ideal equilibrium.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Today's race will be the test. We'll see
if we've
brought our best selves.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Aaaall right! Tarumae, Acute, let's do
this!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's give it everything we've got and
make this
the greatest, happiest race
ever! ☆
